source_scope: WIP after the signed base, not implementation already present at that base. Exact pre-private pins cover 76 source/resources and 23 binaries; source snapshots remain ignored locally. CTest has 15 pre-test source hashes; its full binary set was captured later, before the private check.

private_v1.warmup_scope: Receiver constant-sample validation and recorder attachment start only after ready and at least 1024 output frames. Startup fade samples are excluded; analytic ramp correctness is covered by core tests, not click-free qualification here. Receiver counters are never reset.

source_handoff.scope: Two bounded callback source handoffs on one private virtual graph; muted target, exact audible peer, master recording attached continuously. Startup fade excluded after at least 1024 output frames. Hardware and sustained qualification remain separate.
source_handoff.fault_scope: Helper assertions passed for exact nonzero peer samples, zero invalid buffers, rejected controls, execution misses, starvation and read failures. The focused raw summary emits no separate wrong-sample/fault counters.

native_current.reason: Pending human visibility confirmation; no current native pass claimed.

sustained_current.reason: Harness preparation only; no soak qualification or listening verdict.

soak_harness.scope: Build, syntax, CLI rejection and offline thermal-summary checks only. No native audio/UI or cancellation qualification run.
soak_harness.scope_limit: No native audio/UI, cancellation or sustained run was executed.

prior_failed_native.scope: Prior native v5 failed its frameSwapped/presentation gate; retained unchanged, not promoted to a pass.

limits: Private daemon only: no ALSA, session manager, D-Bus, host graph discovery or physical output.
Startup fade is excluded from exact receiver/WAV validation after at least 1024 output frames; analytic ramps have unit coverage, not click-free listening qualification.
The handoff target is muted; exact peer samples and a continuously attached recorder verify this software path, not audible replacement quality or physical continuity.
Virtual receiver callback spacing is not physical latency or proof of uninterrupted audio.
No current native UI playback, human listening, sustained thermal soak, physical headphone isolation or separate-device drift qualification.
The failed 4.095-second live-stem p99 target remains a mandatory M2 blocker before a usable release.
Only focused text/JSON/config evidence and hashes are copied; recordings, binaries, screenshots, frozen source copies and full daemon logs remain outside Git.
